_comment: Copy to project.json via /art-direction. project.json is THE lock - every generation merges it in, and changing it silently invalidates the consistency of everything generated before. Model names must come from 'comfy.ps1 caps', never from memory.
name: unnamed-style
positive: flat stylised game art, warm palette, soft ambient occlusion, clean readable silhouette, consistent light from upper left
negative: photorealistic, text, watermark, signature, harsh shadows, busy detail, motion blur, depth of field

_notes.positive: Style only. The caller supplies the subject; if the subject ends up in here, every asset starts looking like the same crate.
_notes.negative: Keep it short. Long negatives cost steps and rarely help.
_notes.cfg: On Flux this feeds FluxGuidance, not the sampler. 2.5-4.0 is the usable band.
_notes.seedFamily: Base for the deterministic seed. Same slug always regenerates the same image, which is what makes re-rendering at a higher resolution possible two months later.
